40019870.author: पदार्थः
40019870.content: तस्य his, तत् that, वचनं word, श्रुत्वा having heard, राघवस्य of Rama, महात्मनः of the great-souled, कुम्भयोनिः Agastya, महातेजाः greatly effulgent, रामम् to Rama, एतत् this, उवाच said, ह indeed

40019870.author: Translation
40019870.content: Having heard those words of the great-souled Rama, the greatly effulgent sage Agastya then spoke this to Rama.

40019871.author: पदार्थः
40019871.content: शृणु listen, राम O Rama, कथावृत्तं the story, तस्य his, तेजोबलं might and power, महत् great, जघान killed, शत्रून् enemies, येन by which, असौ he, न च and not, वध्यः to be killed, सः he, शत्रुभिः by enemies

40019871.author: Translation
40019871.content: O Rama, listen to his story, his great might and power, by which he killed his enemies and could not be killed by them.

40019872.author: पदार्थः
40019872.content: तावत् then, ते to you, रावणस्य of Ravana, इदं this, कुलं lineage, जन्म birth, च and, राघव O Raghava, वरप्रदानं granting of boons, च and, तथा thus, तस्मै to him, दत्तं given, ब्रवीमि I will tell, ते to you

40019872.author: Translation
40019872.content: O Raghava, I will now tell you about Ravana's lineage, his birth, and the boons that were granted to him.

40019873.author: पदार्थः
40019873.content: पुरा formerly, कृतयुगे in the Krita Yuga, राम O Rama, प्रजापतिसुतः son of Prajapati, प्रभुः the powerful one, पुलस्त्यो नाम named Pulastya, ब्रह्मर्षिः a Brahmarshi, साक्षादिव as if directly, पितामहः the grandfather (Brahma).

40019873.author: Translation
40019873.content: O Rama, formerly in the Krita Yuga, there was a powerful Brahmarshi named Pulastya, the son of Prajapati, who was verily like Brahma himself.

40019874.author: पदार्थः
40019874.content: न not, अनुकीर्त्या to be fully described, गुणाः qualities, तस्य his, धर्मतः in terms of righteousness, शीलतः in terms of character, तथा and, प्रजापतेः of Prajapati, पुत्रः son, इति thus, वक्तुं to say, शक्यं possible, हि indeed, नामतः by name.

40019874.author: Translation
40019874.content: His qualities, in terms of righteousness and character, could not be fully described; indeed, it was only possible to refer to him by name as the son of Prajapati.

40019875.author: पदार्थः
40019875.content: प्रजापतिसुतत्वेन by virtue of being the son of Prajapati, देवानां of the gods, वल्लभः beloved, हि indeed, सः he, हृष्टः pleased, सर्वस्य of all, लोकस्य the world, गुणैः by qualities, शुभ्रैः pure, महामतिः the great-minded one.

40019875.author: Translation
40019875.content: Indeed, by virtue of being the son of Prajapati, he was beloved by the gods and, being great-minded, he gladdened all the world with his pure qualities.

40019876.author: पदार्थः
40019876.content: सः he, तु indeed, धर्मप्रसङ्गेन for religious purposes, मेरोः of Mount Meru, पार्श्वे on the side, महागिरेः of the great mountain, तृणविन्द्वाश्रमं to the hermitage of Tṛṇavindu, गत्वा having gone, न्यवसत् resided, मुनिपुङ्गवः the foremost among sages.

40019876.author: Translation
40019876.content: Indeed, for religious purposes, that foremost sage went to the hermitage of Tṛṇavindu on the side of the great Mount Meru and resided there.

40019877.author: पदार्थः
40019877.content: सः he, धर्मात्मा the righteous-souled one, स्वाध्यायनियतेन्द्रियः with senses controlled by Vedic study, तपः तेपे performed penance, गत्वा having gone, आश्रमपदं to the hermitage, तस्य his, विघ्नं disturbance, कुर्वन्ति they make, कन्यकाः maidens.

40019877.author: Translation
40019877.content: That righteous-souled sage, with his senses controlled by Vedic study, performed severe penance, but maidens would go to his hermitage and create disturbances.

40019878.author: पदार्थः
40019878.content: देवपन्नगकन्याश्च daughters of gods and serpents, राजर्षितनयाश्च and daughters of royal sages, याः who, क्रीडन्त्यो playing, अप्सरसश्चैव and Apsaras too, तं that, देशम् place, उपपेदिरे reached.

40019878.author: Translation
40019878.content: Daughters of gods, serpents, and royal sages, along with Apsaras, arrived at that place to play.

40019879.author: पदार्थः
40019879.content: सर्वर्तुषृपभोग्यत्वात् due to being enjoyable in all seasons, रम्यत्वात् due to beauty, काननस्य च and of the forest, नित्यशस्तास्तु always, तं that, देशम् place, गत्वा having gone, क्रीडन्ति play, कन्यकाः maidens.

40019879.author: Translation
40019879.content: Because the forest was beautiful and enjoyable in all seasons, these maidens always went to that place to play.

40019880.author: पदार्थः
40019880.content: देशस्य of the place, रमणीयत्वात् due to beauty, पुलस्त्यो Pulastya, यत्र where, स he, द्विजः brahmin, गायन्त्यो singing, वादयन्त्यश्च and playing instruments, लासयन्त्यस्तथैव च and dancing thus, मुनेः of the sage, तपस्विनस्तस्य of that ascetic, विघ्नं obstruction, चक्रुः caused, अनिन्दिताः blameless (maidens).

40019880.author: Translation
40019880.content: Due to the beauty of the place where the brahmin Pulastya resided, the blameless maidens, by singing, playing instruments, and dancing, caused an obstruction to that ascetic sage.

40019881.author: पदार्थः
40019881.content: अथ then, क्रुद्धो angered, महातेजा greatly effulgent, व्याजहार spoke, महामुनिः the great sage, या whoever, मे my, दर्शनम् sight, आगच्छेत् comes, सा she, गर्भं a fetus, धारयिष्यति will bear.

40019881.author: Translation
40019881.content: Then, the greatly effulgent great sage, being angered, declared, "Whoever comes into my sight will conceive a child."

40019882.author: पदार्थः
40019882.content: तास्तु but they, सर्वाः all, प्रतिश्रुत्य having heard, तस्य his, वाक्यं words, महात्मनः of the great soul, ब्रह्मशापभयात् from fear of the brahmin's curse, भीताः frightened, तं that, देशं place, न not, उपचक्रमुः approached.

40019882.author: Translation
40019882.content: But all of them, having heard the words of that great soul, were frightened by the brahmin's curse and no longer approached that place.

40019883.author: पदार्थः
40019883.content: तृणबिन्दोः of Tṛṇabindu, तु indeed, राजर्षेः of the royal sage, तनया daughter, न not, शृणोति hears, तत् that

40019883.author: Translation
40019883.content: But the daughter of the royal sage Tṛṇabindu did not hear that.

40019884.author: पदार्थः
40019884.content: गत्वा having gone, आश्रमपदम् to the hermitage, तत्र there, विचचार she wandered, सुनिर्भया very fearlessly, न not, सा she, अपश्यत् saw, स्थिता present, तत्र there, काञ्चित् any, अभ्यागताम् arrived, सखीम् friend

40019884.author: Translation
40019884.content: Having gone to the hermitage, she wandered there very fearlessly, but she did not see any friend present or arrived there.

40019885.author: पदार्थः
40019885.content: तस्मिन् in that, काले time, महातेजाः greatly effulgent, प्राजापत्यः son of Prajāpati, महानृषिः great sage, स्वाध्यायम् self-study, अकरोत् he performed, तत्र there, तपसा by penance, भावितः purified, स्वयम् himself

40019885.author: Translation
40019885.content: At that time, the greatly effulgent great sage, son of Prajāpati, purified by his own penance, was performing self-study of the Vedas there.

40019886.author: पदार्थः
40019886.content: सा she, तु but, वेदश्रुतिम् the sound of the Vedas, श्रुत्वा having heard, दृष्ट्वा having seen, वै indeed, तपसः of penance, निधिम् the treasure, अभवत् she became, पाण्डुदेहा pale-bodied, सा she, सुव्यञ्जितशरीरजा with clearly manifested bodily signs

40019886.author: Translation
40019886.content: But she, having heard the sound of the Vedas and indeed having seen the repository of penance, became pale-bodied with clearly manifested bodily signs.

40019887.author: पदार्थः
40019887.content: वभूव she became, च and, समुद्विग्ना agitated, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तत् that, दोषम् fault, आत्मनः of herself, इदम् this, मे to me, किन्तु what (is this), इति thus, ज्ञात्वा having known, पितुः of her father, गत्वा having gone, आश्रमे in the hermitage, स्थिता she stayed

40019887.author: Translation
40019887.content: And she became agitated, having seen that fault in herself, and understanding "what is this that has happened to me?", she went and stayed in her father's hermitage.

40019888.author: पदार्थः
40019888.content: तां her, तु indeed, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तथाभूतां in that state, तृणविन्दुः Tṛṇabindu, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, किं why, त्वम् you, एतत् this, त्वसदृशं unbefitting you, धारयसि bear, आत्मनः your own, वपुः body.

40019888.author: Translation
40019888.content: Seeing her in such a transformed state, Tṛṇabindu then asked her why she was bearing a form so unbefitting her true self.

40019889.author: पदार्थः
40019889.content: सा she, तु indeed, कृत्वा having made, अञ्जलिं a respectful salutation, दीना distressed, कन्या the maiden, उवाच spoke, तपोधनम् to the ascetic, न not, जाने I know, कारणं the reason, तात O father, येन by which, मे my, रूपम् form, ईदृशम् is like this.

40019889.author: Translation
40019889.content: The distressed maiden, having respectfully saluted the ascetic, replied that she did not know the reason, O father, why her form had become like this.

40019890.author: पदार्थः
40019890.content: किं तु but, पूर्वं previously, गतास्मि I went, एका alone, महर्षेः of the great sage, भावितात्मनः whose soul is purified, पुलस्त्यस्य of Pulastya, आश्रमं to the hermitage, दिव्यम् divine, अन्वेष्टुं to search for, स्वसखीजनम् my female companions.

40019890.author: Translation
40019890.content: However, she continued, previously she had gone alone to the divine hermitage of the great sage Pulastya, whose soul was purified, to search for her female companions.

40019891.author: पदार्थः
40019891.content: न not, च and, पश्यामि I see, अहं I, तत्र there, काञ्चित् any, अभ्यागतां arrived, सखीम् friend, रूपस्य of the form, तु but, विपर्यासं transformation, दृष्ट्वा having seen, त्रासात् from fear, इह here, आगता I came.

40019891.author: Translation
40019891.content: She added that she did not see any of her friends who had arrived there, but having seen the transformation of her own form, she came here out of fear.

40019892.author: पदार्थः
40019892.content: तृणबिन्दुः Tṛṇabindu, तु indeed, राजर्षिः the royal sage, तपसा by penance, द्योतितप्रभः whose splendor was illuminated, ध्यानं meditation, विवेश entered, तत् that, च and, अपि also, हि indeed, अपश्यत् he saw, ऋषिकर्मजम् born of a sage's action.

40019892.author: Translation
40019892.content: The royal sage Tṛṇabindu, whose splendor was illuminated by his penance, then entered into meditation and indeed perceived that the transformation was due to a sage's action.

40019893.author: पदार्थः
40019893.content: सः He, तु indeed, विज्ञाय having understood, तम् that, शापम् curse, महर्षेः of the great sage, भावितात्मनः of the self-realized one, गृहीत्वा having taken, तनयाम् his daughter, गत्वा having gone, पुलस्त्यम् to Pulastya, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् he said.

40019893.author: Translation
40019893.content: King Trasabindu, having understood the curse from the great self-realized sage, took his daughter and went to Pulastya, to whom he spoke these words.

40019894.author: पदार्थः
40019894.content: भगवन् O revered one, तनयाम् daughter, मे my, त्वम् you, गुणैः with qualities, स्वैः her own, एव indeed, भूषिताम् adorned, भिक्षाम् alms, प्रतिगृहाण please accept, इमाम् this, महर्षे O great sage, स्वयम् by herself, उद्यताम् offered.

40019894.author: Translation
40019894.content: O revered great sage, please accept this daughter of mine, adorned with her own virtues, as an offering that she herself is ready to make.

40019895.author: पदार्थः
40019895.content: तपश्चरणयुक्तस्य of one engaged in ascetic practices, श्रम्यमाणेन्द्रियस्य of one whose senses are fatigued, ते your, शुश्रूषणपरा devoted to service, नित्यम् always, भविष्यति she will be, न no, संशयः doubt.

40019895.author: Translation
40019895.content: She will undoubtedly always be devoted to serving you, whose senses are fatigued from engaging in ascetic practices.

40019896.author: पदार्थः
40019896.content: तम् to him, ब्रुवाणम् who was speaking, तु indeed, तद्वाक्यम् those words, राजर्षिम् to the royal sage, धार्मिकम् righteous, तदा then, जिघृक्षुः desirous of taking, अब्रवीत् he said, कन्याम् the daughter, बाढम् certainly, इति thus, एव indeed, सः that, द्विजः brahmin.

40019896.author: Translation
40019896.content: Then, that brahmin (Pulastya), wishing to accept the daughter, said "Certainly, yes" to the righteous royal sage who was speaking those words.

40019897.author: पदार्थः
40019897.content: दत्त्वा having given, सः he, तु indeed, यथान्यायम् according to custom, स्वम् his own, आश्रमपदम् hermitage, गतः went, सा she, अपि also, तत्र there, अवसत् lived, कन्या the daughter, तोषयन्ती pleasing, पतिम् her husband, गुणैः with her virtues.

40019897.author: Translation
40019897.content: Having properly given his daughter, King Trasabindu returned to his own hermitage, and the daughter also lived there, pleasing her husband with her virtues.

40019898.author: पदार्थः
40019898.content: तस्याः her, तु indeed, शीलवृत्ताभ्यां by character and conduct, तुतोष was pleased, मुनिपुङ्गवः the excellent sage, प्रीतः pleased, स he, तु indeed, महातेजा the greatly effulgent one, वाक्यम् words, एतत् these, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.

40019898.author: Translation
40019898.content: The excellent sage Pulastya was greatly pleased by her character and conduct, and being delighted, the greatly effulgent one spoke these words.

40019899.author: पदार्थः
40019899.content: परितुष्टः completely satisfied, अस्मि I am, सुश्रोणि O beautiful-hipped one, गुणानाम् of qualities, सम्पदा by abundance, भृशम् exceedingly, तस्मात् therefore, देवि O goddess, ददामि I give, अद्य today, पुत्रम् a son, आत्मसमम् equal to myself, तव to you.

40019899.author: Translation
40019899.content: O beautiful-hipped one, I am exceedingly pleased by your abundance of virtues; therefore, O goddess, I grant you today a son equal to myself.

40019900.author: पदार्थः
40019900.content: उभयोः of both, वंशकर्तारम् the progenitor of the lineage, पौलस्त्यः Pulastya, इति thus, विश्रुतम् renowned, यस्मात् because, तु indeed, विश्रुतः heard, वेदः the Veda, त्वया by you, एषः this, अध्ययतः while studying, मम my.

40019900.author: Translation
40019900.content: He will be renowned as the progenitor of both our lineages, and because you heard this Veda while I was reciting it.

40019901.author: पदार्थः
40019901.content: तस्मात् therefore, स he, विश्रवा Vishrava, नाम named, भविष्यति will be, न not, संशयः doubt, एवम् thus, उक्ता spoken to, तु indeed, सा she, देवी the goddess, प्रहृष्टेन delighted, अन्तरात्मना with her inner self.

40019901.author: Translation
40019901.content: Therefore, he will undoubtedly be named Vishrava; thus addressed, that goddess, with a delighted heart.

40019902.author: पदार्थः
40019902.content: अचिरेण in a short time, एव indeed, कालेन by time, असूत gave birth, विश्रवसम् Vishravas, सुतम् a son, त्रिषु in three, लोकेषु worlds, विख्यातं renowned, यशोधर्मसमन्वितम् endowed with fame and righteousness.

40019902.author: Translation
40019902.content: In a short time, she gave birth to a son named Vishravas, who became renowned in the three worlds and was endowed with fame and righteousness.

40019903.author: पदार्थः
40019903.content: श्रुतिमान् possessed of scriptural knowledge, समदर्शी one who sees all equally, च and, व्रताचाररतः devoted to vows and observances, तथा also, पिता इव like his father, तपसा with austerity, युक्तः endowed, हि indeed, अभवत् became, विश्रवाः Vishrava, मुनिः a sage.

40019903.author: Translation
40019903.content: Sage Vishrava became learned in scriptures, impartial, devoted to vows and observances, and indeed, like his father, engaged in severe austerities. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे द्वितीयः सर्गः ।। 2 ।। Thus ends the second sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
